This post exists so the accessibility suite can scan a real article page in CI.

## What this fixture covers

It is intentionally small: one article page with a heading and a short body.

### Structure

- A plain paragraph keeps the reading column populated.
- Headings keep the table of contents meaningful.

> Fixtures are not site content; they are only materialized in CI.
